name: Fekre's Fever
summary: Immunity to poison, and Blight once per long rest. The price: Charisma -2, and every healing spell or potion does you only half its good.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_faceless_god (the ring of amber).

benefit.text: Every sickness you will ever catch has already passed through you and moved in. Poison finds nothing left to spoil, and once a day you can breathe the rot out onto someone else.

cost.flaw: Sickness keeps you company. Milk sours where you sleep, dogs cough when you pass, and whoever nurses you falls ill.
cost.text: Your body has made room for the fever and none for mending: healing from spells and potions restores only half as many Hit Points to you.

implemented: partial: halved healing is text only (the engine has no 'healing received' modifier yet).
